characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.note: Consulting detective; narrator's friend and flatmate in Baker Street.

characters.name: Dr. Watson
characters.note: Narrator; Holmes's friend and biographer, a former army doctor.

characters.name: Lord Robert St. Simon
characters.note: Aristocratic bridegroom, second son of the Duke of Balmoral.

characters.name: Hatty Doran
characters.note: American heiress who married Lord St. Simon, then left and later married Francis Moulton.

characters.name: Francis Hay Moulton
characters.note: Hatty's former fiancé and first husband, believed dead, now alive.

characters.name: Lestrade
characters.note: Inspector of Scotland Yard working the case.

characters.name: Flora Millar
characters.note: Former dancer at the Allegro, Lord St. Simon's earlier companion; arrested.

characters.name: Alice
characters.note: Hatty's American maid, who had known Francis in California.

characters.name: Aloysius Doran
characters.note: Californian millionaire, father of the bride.

locations.name: Baker Street lodgings
locations.note: Holmes and Watson's rooms, where the interviews take place.

locations.name: St. George's, Hanover Square
locations.note: Church where the wedding was performed.

locations.name: Doran house, Lancaster Gate
locations.note: Wedding breakfast location where the bride vanished.

locations.name: Hyde Park
locations.note: Park into which the bride walked and was seen with Flora Millar.

locations.name: the Serpentine
locations.note: Lake in Hyde Park that Lestrade dragged for the bride's body.

locations.name: Gordon Square lodgings
locations.note: Lodgings where the Moultons went after the wedding.

brief.place: Baker Street lodgings in London; Hanover Square church; Lancaster Gate house; Hyde Park; the Serpentine; a Gordon Square lodging.
brief.dress: Victorian formal and daywear: frock-coats, high collars, white waistcoats, yellow gloves for Lord St. Simon; ulster and bonnet for the bride; wedding dress of watered silk with veil and white satin shoes; pea-jacket and cravat for Lestrade; American Westerner Moulton is sunburnt and clean-shaven.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Shabby Baker Street sitting room with fireplace, basket-chair, mahogany table, cigars and whisky; the supper of woodcock, pheasant and pâté; the crested letter; the ivory miniature locket; the wet wedding dress and wreath; the pencilled note; the hotel bill; the wedding breakfast room with a window onto the Park.
depiction_rules: Show Holmes and Watson in the Baker Street room, not the hotel or church, unless a unit is set there.
Lord St. Simon should appear stiff and aristocratic, eyeglasses swinging on a cord.
Hatty Doran should be shown as a lovely, lively woman with dark hair and large dark eyes.
Do not depict the Serpentine or the body; only the dragged clothing is seen.
Depict the Moultons as Western American frontier figures, contrasted with the English gentry.
